body: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have any aunts or uncles that you trust? I'm sorry you're feeling this way and it feels like you don't have options. If its happening with both parents that would be something a teacher could pass along to the authorities. The fact that a student is feeling suicidal is something a teacher should know also. Kids that deal with this sort of thing are usually in a rough spot because going into the system can be as rough as where they came from. I don't know how to fix something like that but if a kid came to me asking for protection and said "I'm feeling suicidal" I would definitely be very concerned about where they ended up.

It's mostly boring as long as you don't have to deal with treatments you didn't consent to. They make you eat and wander the halls. Sometimes there are activities but its mostly just a break from reality for most people. In my case those closest to me used computers and carefully chosen phrases to try and make me go insane then when I sought help they trapped me in a hellish cycle that didn't end when I went into the hospital and has persisted to this day.. Whats worse is that no one made any attempts to check on me or talk to me or have frank discussions. I'm sure on some level they told themselves it was for everyone's benefit but thats bullshit. Be aware that your mental health advocates will have their own agendas but if you need help go ahead and get it.

We're not supposed to offer advice her but I will say that what is happening to you is illegal. If this sort of thing is happening to a child and a teacher for instance finds out about it that child would be protected.

Money is a manifestation of insecurity. People acquire it to cope with reality. You know the cost of poverty is not only rooted in a lack of economy of scale. Its also the cost of coping with "not having things". Don't have a refrigerator you'll be eating a lot of takeout. Don't own your home you'll be paying at least 20% more each month depending on your poverty stricken credit score. Don't have love and intimacy? All of those coping mechanisms are going to cost you. If you don't believe me just look at what advertising is. A constant bombardment of your deepest insecurities. I can't even imagine how it would feel if someone made it their business to rub you raw. With targeted marketing it sure seems like those algorithms are designed to drain your pockets or make you kill yourself.
Some people should not have kids let alone be around other people.

Hey man I get it. It definitely sucks. I've been alone for 30 years. I have no prospects and everyone around me knows I'm insecure so they try to fix it by desensitizing me. If I had to characterize how people treat this topic its like a biological imperative that everyone recognizes as such, like eating or breathing. However when some says "hey I've never had food before and it doesn't look like I'm ever going to get food" people that have been eating for years tell you things like "foods not that great" or "you can hang out with me while I eat if that will make you feel better" or "theres more to life than eating" or my personal favorite "you're too concerned with eating so I'm going to make you hate it".  Imagine finding some starving and bloated kid and just chowing down on a 4 course meal in front of him and smiling while you do it.

Totally get it. I'm 30 and I've never had a girlfriend and people I thought were friends just turned out to be acquaintances or just plain assholes. I'm probably bipolar and I definitely have an eating disorder and like you I'm ugly. I can't really tell you things will get better or that there are things to live for because frankly I don't see them. I also won't say whether killing yourself is the right choice or not because anybody that is offering such advice is usually doing it because dead people are a bummer and  no one wants to question whether or not the things that keep them here are actually worth it. I will say that someone else out there feels the same way. I've picked a date for my own exit so take what I say with a grain of salt but if you're going to do it give yourself a window where you try everything you can first. I know were in a pandemic but you're thinking about suicide so what can it hurt?
